{{Short description|Italian mathematician (1777–1849)}}
{{Orphan|date=February 2024}}
[[File:Magistrini - Facilis et universalis delineatio geometrica umbrarum, 1816 - 618132.tif|thumb|''Facilis, et universalis delineatio geometrica umbrarum'', 1816]]

'''Giambattista Magistrini''' (1777 – 1849) was an [[Italians|Italian]] [[mathematician]].

From 1804 he was professor of [[calculation]] at the [[University of Bologna]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.treccani.it/enciclopedia/giambattista-magistrini|title=Magistrini, Giambattista|publisher=[[Treccani.it]]|language=it}}</ref>

From 1811 he was a fellow of the [[Accademia nazionale delle scienze]].<ref>{{cite book|title=La Società italiana delle scienze un secolo dopo la fondazione|location=Napoli|publisher=Tip. della R. Accademia delle scienze fis. e mat.|date=1882|page=87|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=KO0AAAAAYAAJ&pg=PA87|language=it}}</ref>
